verdict.rationale: The evidence pack has no documented export of all data in open formats such as CSV, Parquet or SQL dumps. Backup/restore and changefeeds are related but different capabilities: backups are for restoring into CockroachDB, and changefeeds are change streams with no stated open format. PostgreSQL wire-protocol compatibility is only a building block for a user-side export workaround.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
